name: LG Laundry Specialist
author: Bryan
summary: Maps plain-language laundry requests to LG ThinQ washer and dryer cycles and can start them after Remote Start is enabled.
starterPrompt: Choose the right washer and dryer cycles for this load and show me the settings before starting anything.
usageNote: Check garment labels, machine settings, and Remote Start status yourself. Keep appliance credentials private and approve each cycle.
